parameters.content:
## ask_fr
Entry: a Planka card event (cardCreate/cardMoved) whose webhook path is <card_type>.<LIST>, or another workflow calling this one with event, card_id, board_id, list, card_type.
Triggers: Webhook (production) + When executed by another workflow (kata replay / tests).
Agents never write to the card and never move it: the flow posts every comment and does every create/move.

## How it works
1. Trigger: When executed by another workflow with card_id, board_id, project_id, list, card_type, slot, ask_kind (question|signoff), question, draft, field, artifact_ref, expires_in_hours.
2. Ask object: normalises and validates the ask.
3. Resolve project by Planka board -> Context (list ids from RM's planka_list_ids).
4. Raise ask: fr approvals.createExecutionApproval (draft is sent as metadata.proposed_answer, which a bare approve accepts) with callbackUrl = $execution.resumeUrl and, when artifact_ref is a UUID, artifactRef {artifact_id} (fr D13: the one artifact the approval is about; fr 422s an artifact outside the project, 409s a different ref on an open gate).
5. Comment block: tells the board what is being asked, before the wait.
6. Wait for answer: resumes on fr's POST.
7. Read answer: fr getApproval (fresh) -> Answer: {approval_id, decision, answer, has_answer}.
8. fr keeps one open gate per card: a deduplicated raise returns the OLDER approval and the Wait resumes when it is decided. Same question -> its answer is used. Different question -> Answer final? (false) -> Re-ask raises this question again, once; still deduplicated the second time -> decision deduplicated, no answer.

## Gates and exit
Callers: every card-type DOING/QA agent's ask_user tool (toolWorkflow).
fam: fr holds ONE open approval per card, so callers ask one question at a time.
fr allows the callback because $execution.resumeUrl is https://n8n.example.com/webhook-waiting/...
